verdicts.rationale: Both are Shoemaker, 'Persons and Their Pasts', same DOI. Survivor is the 1970 American Philosophical Quarterly original (indexed); loser Shoemaker1970 is the 2003 reprint in 'Identity, Cause, and Mind'. Reprint of the same work; only survivor indexed. Merge OK.
Both 'Functionalism and qualia', Shoemaker 1975, Philosophical Studies 27(5):291-315, identical DOI and fields. Duplicate import under a different citekey. Neither indexed.
Both Sidelle review 'Ordinary Objects - Amie Thomasson' 2008, Phil Quarterly 58(230):172-176, same DOI. Zotero-style key vs hand key of the same work; survivor indexed.
Both Sidelle 'Conventionalism and the Contingency of Conventions' 2009, Noûs 43(2):224-241, same DOI (loser only adds italics markup). Same work; survivor indexed.
Both Sidelle 'Modality and Objects' 2010, Phil Quarterly 60(238):109-125, same DOI. Duplicate under Zotero-style key; survivor indexed.

verdicts.id: writing the book of the world
verdicts.rationale: All four are Sider, 'Writing the Book of the World', same ISBN 9780199697908. Survivor is preprint/manuscript, sider2011writing the published book (both indexed, same book); sider2013/sider2013writing are shadow keys with no folder. Same work throughout.
Survivor is Sider 'Logic for Philosophy' 2010 published (OUP). Loser sider2007logic is the 2007 unpublished manuscript version of the same book (preprint vs published). Same work; folder aliased.
Both Siegel 'How does visual phenomenology constrain object-seeing?' 2006, AJP 84(3):429-441, same DOI. Duplicate under Zotero-style key; survivor indexed.

All are Siegel 'The Contents of Visual Experience', a 2010 OUP monograph, ISBN 9780199931248 (year noise 2010/2011/2012, but same ISBN/title). Survivor indexed; losers are duplicate/shadow keys, none independently indexed. Same book.
Both Simons & Danks 'Creating Coherence with Concepts' 2024 manuscript, identical note. Duplicate import; survivor indexed.
Both Singh 'Modal and Amodal Completion Generate Different Shapes' 2004, Psych Science 15(7):454-459, identical DOI and fields. Duplicate under Zotero-style key; survivor indexed.
Both Skrzypulec 'Particularity of Content and Illusions of Identity' 2018, Axiomathes 28(5):491-506, identical DOI and fields. Duplicate under Zotero-style key; survivor indexed.
